Subject: Your consumer complaint matter

Dear Mr. Hegde,

Thank you for meeting us on 30 December 2025 about your dispute with M/s Dutta Developers. As we understand it, the flat was handed over with serious construction defects.

Our advice is to commission a structural audit report on the defects before the first hearing. Please collect photographs of the defects and a structural audit report and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹3.5 crore.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
